_doc: ADR-0064 D-B/D-002: T-1 research-round baseline harness. Records the attribution baseline AS-IS: detector v2 core split on the frozen external bench (README Run 2, metrics-v2-run4.json). The freeze pin covers ONLY the confirmatory threshold surface; the g6_gates class is exempt because ADR-0064 D-E sanctions writing it before any JS porting line. Machine-checked by scripts/check-research-baseline.js (gates.json: research-baseline).

baseline.detector_note: detector v2 core split, README Run 2 (2026-08-27, pre-ADR-0020 pairing state). The v1 overall figure (34.7%) is a historical reference only and is never mixed into T-6 attribution (D-002 item 4).

historical_reference.note: v1 overall metric; historical reference only, never an attribution argument

freeze.exempt_reason: ADR-0064 D-E: the G6 threshold class is pre-registered into thresholds.json BEFORE any JS porting line; it is a new threshold class, not a tuning of the confirmatory surface

waiver.clause: ADR-0059 D-C is NOT invoked: ADR-0064 D-004(5) closes the bifurcation — T-6 is a research round that carries the MDE stop-loss commitment
